definitions.notes: Static economy/draw roles are curated screening labels, not guaranteed payouts. Accessible economy means printed startup cost at most the opening five credits; its effect may still require clicks, a run, a discard, or another condition. Exact hypergeometric opening probabilities ignore mulligans, extra draws and identity effects. Printed end-the-run text includes conditional stopping ice; virus, AI, tutor and bypass strategies require manual review. AI benchmarks screen implementation and policy behavior, not human fun or competitive strength.
